title: Coherent derived comparison of the perfect target model
statement: Fix derived localizations on all schemes and open sites [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $W$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq W$ an open, $E\in D(\mathcal O_W)$, and $K$ a strictly perfect complex on the open site [def-pc-perfect-complex], with $E|_U\cong QK$. Let $P_s$, $w:P_{s\prime}\cong i^*P_s$, and $\eta_i$ be as in [def-sc-picard-termwise-models]. There are $b_{t,s,h}:Lt^*E\cong QP_s$ for every $h:s;U.\iota=t$. For every $i:T\prime\to T$, compatible equalities $i;t=t\prime$ and $i;s=s\prime$, and both factorizations $h,h\prime$, they satisfy $b_{t\prime,s\prime,h\prime}.\mathrm{hom};Q(w.\mathrm{hom})=c.\mathrm{inv}(E);Li^*(b_{t,s,h}.\mathrm{hom});\eta_i(P_s)$, where $c$ is the pinned derived composition comparison [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. This assertion involves no source single or chain map, and has no connectivity hypothesis. Derived pullback is that of [def-pc-derived-pullback].

proof.text: Transport the strictly perfect model across the exact open-site equivalence; it remains bounded and each term is a finite-free retract, hence flat. Apply the bounded-flat counit.
Use compatibility with exact open restriction and the fixed representing isomorphism to construct b for each factorization through U.

Use associativity of the pinned derived composition and its defining counit equation on the transported K-flat model. Naturality moves the fixed representing isomorphism across the square; equality transports agree by proof irrelevance.

theorem picard_termwise_target_coherence
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (E : schemeDerivedCategory W) (U : W.Opens)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect W U K)
    (hE : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) :
    ∃ b : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (t : T ⟶ W) (s : T ⟶ U.toScheme),
        s ≫ U.ι = t → ((derivedPullback t).obj E ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj (picardTermwiseModel W U K s)),
      ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{v}} (i : T' ⟶ T) (t : T ⟶ W) (t' : T' ⟶ W)
        (s : T ⟶ U.toScheme) (s' : T' ⟶ U.toScheme)
        (ht : i ≫ t = t') (hs : i ≫ s = s')
        (hf : s ≫ U.ι = t) (hf' : s' ≫ U.ι = t'),
      let c := (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))) i t ≪≫
          eqToIso (congrArg (fun g : T' ⟶ W ↦ derivedPullback g) ht)
      (b t' s' hf').hom ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (picardTermwiseModelRestrictionIso W U K i s s' hs).hom =
        c.inv.app E ≫ (derivedPullback i).map (b t s hf).hom ≫
          (picardTermwiseCounit i).app (picardTermwiseModel W U K s)
